show_text_underline.label: Show text underline
show_text_underline.info: The underline spans the full text width

description.default: Use this space to describe the purpose of this block, such as showcasing craftsmanship, product benefits, or an exclusive offer.

main_text.label: Heading
main_text.default: Add a powerful message right here

position_x.label: Position by horizontal
position_x.info: Horizontal block positioning is only available on desktop.

position_y.label: Position by vertical
position_y.info: Vertical block positioning is only available on desktop.

image_rotate.label: Image rotate
image_rotate.info: The recommended range is from 0 to 360 degrees

description.default: This section enhances the browsing experience by providing an interactive way for visitors to explore different sections of your store or website through visually engaging tabs.

text.default: Use this space to expand on product specifications, including exact measurements, included accessories, or specific usage recommendations.

image_width.label: Image width
image_width.info: For mobile devices the value will be reduced.

hero_description.label: Description
hero_description.default: Use this space to provide details about what’s being featured in this section.

section_heading.default: Add a powerful message right here

hero_text_align.label: Hero text alignment
hero_text_align.info: Alignment works when the text width is less than 100%. On mobile devices, alignment is always centered.

use_section_images.label: Use section images
use_section_images.info: Always display the section’s main "Image" and "Mobile image" instead of swapping in block-specific images on slide change.

overwrite_desc.label: Overwrite description
overwrite_desc.default: Here can be a description of the product, its key features and benefits.

show_nav_buttons_mobile.label: Show slider navigation buttons on mobile

enable_loop.label: Enable loop for slider
enable_loop.info: Works only when the total number of slides is 3 more than the "Slides per view".

centered_slides.label: Centered slides
centered_slides.info: Works only when the "Slides per view" setting is set to 3 or 5, and the total number of slides is 3 more than the "Slides per view".

paragraph.content: This menu only appears in the 'Compact' and 'Burger' header layouts when 'Blocks' is selected in the Burger menu type settings.
